input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
input.rationale: Arizona law is outside our approved list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), and Section 19 imposes mandatory binding arbitration under the U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules with no agreed seat, whereas our position is court resolution. We replaced the governing law with New York and set exclusive jurisdiction in the New York County courts in both places; Delaware or California is our fallback.

input.quote: Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: The mutual consent requirement has no carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in an M&A transaction, and the agreement is silent on change of control. We added the affiliate/successor carve-out and confirmed that a change of control of Company is not an assignment and gives Contractor no termination or re-pricing right.
